title: Non-blocking follow-up from PR #169 review (frontend-tide-region-chart-shading)
description: Tracked non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #169 (frontend-tide-region-chart-shading), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges. Distinct from the PR's own blocking finding (buildTideRegionSegments never extending the trailing boundary of the LAST segment, so a solo 1-bar final segment renders no fill), which stays on frontend-tide-region-chart-shading itself and must be fixed before that PR can be accepted.

checklist.step: tideRegionHelp.interpretValue (frontend/src/features/stocks/components/metricHelpContent.ts, ~line 762-777) rounds the Bullish/Bearish/Neutral percentages of the currently visible bars independently (Math.round per count), so the three displayed percentages don't always sum to 100% -- e.g. a 3-bar 1/1/1 split reads '33% Bullish, 33% Bearish, 33% Neutral' (99% total). Cosmetic, but worth fixing (e.g. compute two shares directly and derive the third as the remainder to 100%) since a careful reader will notice the numbers don't add up.
